ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا ۝١
ayahs.translation: By those [angels] who extract with violence[1833]

footnotes.1833: i.e., those who tear out the souls of those destined for Hell.

ayahs.translationClear: By those who snatch violently.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا ۝٢
ayahs.translation: And [by] those who remove with ease[1834]

footnotes.1834: i.e., those angels who ease out the souls of those destined for Paradise.

ayahs.translationClear: And those who remove gently.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا ۝٣
ayahs.translation: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming[1835]
ayahs.translationClear: And those who glide smoothly.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا ۝٤

words.translation: And those who race each other

ayahs.translation: And those who race each other in a race[1836]

footnotes.1836: Racing to deliver the souls of the believers to Paradise.

ayahs.translationClear: And those who race swiftly.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا ۝٥
ayahs.translation: And those who arrange [each] matter,[1837]
ayahs.translationClear: And those who regulate events.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ ۝٦
ayahs.translation: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the Quake quakes.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ ۝٧
ayahs.translation: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
ayahs.translationClear: And is followed by the Successor.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: Hearts,[1838] that Day, will tremble,

footnotes.1838: Those of the disbelievers who denied the Resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: Hearts on that Day will be pounding.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: Their eyes[1839] humbled.
ayahs.translationClear: Their sights downcast.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
ayahs.translationClear: They say, “Are we to be restored to the original condition?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً ۝١١
ayahs.translation: Even if we should be decayed bones?"[1840]

footnotes.1840: The disbelievers say this in ridicule of the warning.

ayahs.translationClear: When we have become hollow bones?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ ۝١٢
ayahs.translation: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."[1841]

footnotes.1841: i.e., "If that were so, we would not be able to escape punishment."

ayahs.translationClear: They say, “This is a losing proposition.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ ۝١٣
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
ayahs.translationClear: But it will be only a single nudge.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ ۝١٤
ayahs.translation: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
ayahs.translationClear: And they will be awake.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
ayahs.translationClear: Has the story of Moses reached you?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذۡ نَادٰٮهُ رَبُّهٗ بِالۡوَادِ الۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,
ayahs.transliteration: Ith nadaahu rabbuhu bil-waadil muqad-dasi tuwa
ayahs.translationClear: When his Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
ayahs.translationClear: “Go to Pharaoh—he has transgressed.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقُلۡ هَلۡ لَّكَ اِلٰٓى اَنۡ تَزَكّٰى ۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
ayahs.transliteration: Faqul hal laka ilaa an tazakka
ayahs.translationClear: And say, “Do you care to be cleansed?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ ۝١٩
ayahs.translation: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
ayahs.translationClear: And I will guide you to your Lord, and you will turn reverent.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: And he showed him the greatest sign,[1842]

footnotes.1842: i.e., the miracle of his staff becoming a great snake.

ayahs.translationClear: He showed him the greatest miracle.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.
ayahs.translationClear: But he denied and defied.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].[1843]

footnotes.1843: An alternative meaning is "running [from the snake]."

ayahs.translationClear: Then turned his back, and tried.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: And he gathered [his people] and called out
ayahs.translationClear: And gathered and proclaimed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۝٢٤
ayahs.translation: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I am your Lord, the most high.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].[1844].

footnotes.1844: i.e., for Pharaoh's setting himself up as a deity and for his previous oppression of the people and denial of Moses.

ayahs.translationClear: So Allah seized him with an exemplary punishment, in the last and in the first.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةً لِّمَنۡ يَّخۡشٰىؕ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee thaalika la'ibratal limaiy yaksha
ayahs.translationClear: In this is a lesson for whoever fears.

ayahs.textUthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ‌ۚ بَنَىٰهَا ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: ءَاَنۡتُمۡ اَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا اَمِ السَّمَآءُ​ ؕ بَنٰٮهَا‏
ayahs.translation: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
ayahs.transliteration: A-antum a-shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha
ayahs.translationClear: Are you more difficult to create, or the heaven? He constructed it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
ayahs.translationClear: He raised its masses, and proportioned it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.[1845]

footnotes.1845: i.e., created the day from within the surrounding darkness.

ayahs.translationClear: And He dimmed its night, and brought out its daylight.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: And after that He spread the earth.
ayahs.translationClear: And the earth after that He spread.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا ۝٣١
ayahs.translation: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
ayahs.translationClear: And from it, He produced its water and its pasture.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا ۝٣٢
ayahs.translation: And the mountains He set firmly
ayahs.translationClear: And the mountains, He anchored.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ ۝٣٣
ayahs.translation: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.translationClear: A source of enjoyment for you and for your animals.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity[1846] -
ayahs.translationClear: But when the Great Cataclysm arrives.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
ayahs.translationClear: A Day when man will remember what he has endeavored.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
ayahs.translationClear: And Hell will be displayed to whoever sees.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ ۝٣٧
ayahs.translation: So as for he who transgressed
ayahs.translationClear: As for him who was defiant.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: And preferred the life of the world,
ayahs.translationClear: And preferred the life of this world.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ۝٣٩
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.translationClear: Then Hell is the shelter.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهٖ وَ نَهَى النَّفۡسَ عَنِ الۡهَوٰىۙ‏
ayahs.translation: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord[1847] and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee Wa-nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa
ayahs.translationClear: But as for him who feared the standing of his Lord, and restrained the self from desires.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ۝٤١
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.translationClear: Then Paradise is the shelter.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا ۝٤٢
ayahs.translation: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?[1848]
ayahs.translationClear: They ask you about the Hour, “When will it take place?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ ۝٤٣
ayahs.translation: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?[1849]

footnotes.1849: Meaning that Muḥammad (ﷺ) had no knowledge of it, so how could he inform them?

ayahs.translationClear: You have no knowledge of it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ ۝٤٤
ayahs.translation: To your Lord is its finality.[1850]

footnotes.1850: i.e., its destination and termination. And to Him belongs ultimate knowledge of it.

ayahs.translationClear: To your Lord is its finality.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا ۝٤٥
ayahs.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
ayahs.translationClear: You are just a warner for whoever dreads it.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: كَاَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوۡۤا اِلَّا عَشِيَّةً اَوۡ ضُحٰٮهَا‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: It will be, on the Day they see it,[1851] as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ayahs.transliteration: Ka-annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when they witness it—as though they only stayed an evening, or its morning.
